# Voyager

> A better workspace for your AI chats -- an open-source browser extension that adds timeline navigation, folder organization, prompt vault, chat export, and 20+ productivity features to Google Gemini and AI Studio, and extends Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek through its plugin engine.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager)
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/voyager/iifacdnjakkhjjiengaffnegbndgingi)
- [Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/voyager/gibmkggjijalcjinbdhcpklodjkhhlne)
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/gemini-voyager/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/privacy)
- [Installation Guide](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/installation)

## About

Voyager is an open-source (GPLv3) browser extension that transforms the Google Gemini and AI Studio experience, and carries the same ideas to Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek through the Voyager Plugin Engine. Its Prompt Manager can be pointed at any site you add, local apps included. It works on Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Opera, and Brave. All data is stored locally in the browser with optional Google Drive cloud sync. No tracking, no data collection.

### Core Features

- **Timeline Navigation**: Visual conversation navigator with clickable nodes, Nodes/Ruler/Compact styles, a pinnable preview panel with search, Vim-style keyboard shortcuts (j/k/gg/GG), starred bookmarks, and collapsible message levels
- **Folder Organization**: Drag-and-drop folders for Gemini and AI Studio conversations with nesting, custom colors, account isolation, and multi-select moves
- **Activity View**: Sort folder conversations by real chat activity so threads that are still moving come first
- **Prompt Vault**: Save, tag, and reuse prompts with one-click insertion into the composer
- **Chat Export**: Export Gemini conversations to Markdown, PDF, JSON, or an image -- full data ownership with no lock-in
- **Cloud Sync**: Back up folders, prompts, starred messages, settings, and plugin configuration to Google Drive, or to iCloud on Safari
- **Formula Copy**: Click a formula to copy it as LaTeX, MathML (Word), or Notion-ready math
- **Deep Research Export**: Extract research processes, thinking steps, and source links from Gemini Deep Research sessions
- **Mermaid Diagrams**: Render flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, and more inline in conversations
- **Image Refinement**: Lossless watermark removal from Gemini-generated images
- **Quote Reply**: Select any text in a conversation to quote and reply with context
- **Batch Delete**: Select multiple conversations and delete them all at once
- **Default Model**: Auto-switch to your preferred Gemini model on every new chat
- **Usage Status Bar**: Gemini's daily and weekly usage limits in a small draggable bar inside the chat
- **Recent Gems in Sidebar**: Expand Gemini's Gems entry into a list of pinned and recently used gems
- **Message Timestamps**: Auto-record when each message was sent
- **Sidebar Auto-hide**: Sidebar collapses when your mouse leaves for distraction-free conversations
- **Conversation Fork**: Branch any conversation at any message node to explore different directions
- **Send Behavior**: Choose between Enter-to-send or Ctrl/⌘+Enter-to-send
- **Font Size Control**: Adjust chat font size for comfortable reading

### Plugin Platform Features

Beyond Gemini, these run on the Voyager Plugin Engine:

- **Timeline** (Claude, ChatGPT; optional plugin on DeepSeek): The same timeline, with starred messages and search
- **Folders** (ChatGPT): Organize ChatGPT conversations into folders; on by default
- **Chat Export** (ChatGPT): Export a conversation as Markdown, JSON, PDF, or an image
- **Formula Copy** (Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek): Click a formula to copy its LaTeX
- **Vim Input** (Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek): Vim-style modal editing and cursor navigation in the composer
- **Comfortable Reading Width** (Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek): Adjustable centered reading column
- **Everyday helpers** (Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek): Quote replies, Ctrl/⌘+Enter to send, and a draft counter; draft auto-save on Claude and DeepSeek
- **CJK Render Fix** (Claude): Fixes CJK character rendering
- **Code Wrapping** (DeepSeek): Long code lines scroll sideways instead of wrapping, so indentation survives
- **Prompt Manager** (any site you add, localhost included): The prompt vault follows you off Gemini

### Write your own plugin

Users can make local plugins (a declarative `plugin.json` plus CSS, no code) for Gemini, AI Studio, ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek and import them in the popup.

- [Guide](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/write-a-plugin)
- [Agent skill](https://voyager.nagi.fun/skills/write-voyager-plugin/SKILL.md): the full authoring contract for coding agents
- [Manifest JSON Schema](https://voyager.nagi.fun/plugin.schema.json)
- `npx create-voyager-plugin@latest init|check`: scaffold a plugin and run the import checks offline

### What Makes Voyager Different

Voyager is designed as a comprehensive workspace layer for AI chat, not just a single-feature extension. It combines navigation, organization, export, and customization into one cohesive tool. Unlike alternatives that focus on one aspect or one site, Voyager provides a unified experience across Gemini and AI Studio, extends it to Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek through a declarative plugin engine, and lets the Prompt Manager follow you to any site you add. Full privacy (local-only storage), cross-browser support, and 10-language localization.

### Supported Platforms

- Google Gemini (gemini.google.com) -- full feature set
- Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) -- folders, prompts, sidebar width, formula copy, send behavior
- Gemini for Enterprise (business.gemini.google) -- Prompt Manager only
- Claude (claude.ai) -- plugin platform
- ChatGPT (chatgpt.com, chat.openai.com) -- plugin platform
- DeepSeek (chat.deepseek.com) -- plugin platform
- Any site you add in the extension popup, localhost included -- Prompt Manager
- Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Opera, Brave
